mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero mean).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.4 percentage point rise in unemployment rate over three months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and triggers negative S&P 500 returns within five trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.4pp in 3 months (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105) during supply chain normalization reduces input costs and boosts corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105 (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers Fed tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns within five trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained employment growth above 150,000 monthly additions (PAYEMS > 150,000) supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 150,000 (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions with high consumer spending (RSAFS > 450,000 million dollars), S&P 500 underperforms as markets anticipate rate hikes, generating negative forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansion (RSAFS > 450,000) (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signal severe supply chain disruptions that depress economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 returns within five trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and HOUST fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).
